name: Good Finance Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Good Finance Securities Co., Ltd., including its subsidiaries, operates as a prominent financial services provider in Taiwan, primarily focusing on the securities commission agency and brokerage sector. The company's diverse operations are organized into distinct divisions: Client Partner, Investment, Investment Bank, Futures, and All Other. Beyond its core brokerage activities, Good Finance Securities is also deeply involved in a variety of financial dealings. This includes trading securities and bonds on its own account, as well as managing transactions for financial instruments such as interest rate products, bills, and bonds, frequently utilizing repurchase or resale agreements. The firm further provides services in securities underwriting and offers both agency and brokerage for futures trading. Clients also benefit from the company's research and analysis, which supports informed securities investment decisions. The company's offerings extend to facilitating the buying and selling of marketable securities on the centralized exchange market, administering margin purchases and short sales, and executing consignment trades for foreign securities. Additionally, it acts as an agent for stock-related affairs, delivers specialized securities investment consulting, and engages in a range of other ancillary securities-related businesses. Founded in 1988, the company was initially named Ta Ching Securities Co., Ltd. before rebranding to Good Finance Securities Co., Ltd. in December 2021. Its headquarters are situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.
